Appia Antica Sud — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

This zone covers the southern stretch of the Appia Antica archaeological park, further from the city center and more rural in character, with ancient tombs, villas and countryside. As with the northern section, documented issues in current press relate mainly to park governance rather than crime against visitors. No specific safety incidents were found for this area in current local press; being a low-traffic, sparsely populated rural stretch, it is quieter and less overseen after dark than during the day.
